title: Anthonie
summary: Raleigh names Anthonie in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Anthonie, husband of Cleopatra Queene of Aegypt. He is not the Antonius who names Thanis. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter X, §. III, sig. 243b
